document_title: Pre-Characterization Process Risk Assessment — A-Mab Drug Substance
schema_note: Blocks validate against nlp_reports app/models; parameter_type, document_type, QualityAttribute criticality fields, StudyDesign and DesignSpace are local extensions (see schema_extensions_used).
out_of_schema_notes: Pre-characterization: parameter_type is left 'unclassified' (CPP/WC-CPP/KPP/GPP is an OUTPUT of the studies, not this assessment).
The study-type assignment (multivariate DoE / justified univariate / univariate) and the prospective severity/initial-RPN ranking are reported via report_sections and parameter rationales.

parameter_impacts_attribute here is a PROSPECTIVE (at-risk) relation, not a demonstrated effect; each is anchored on the ranking row that states the postulated failure mode and the attribute it could reach.
No residual RPN and no design space are recorded, because the document states neither: the control strategy that would reduce the risk does not yet exist.

statements.statement_text: RA-001 decides which A-Mab process parameters are characterized and by what kind of study; its output is the characterization scope, not a result.

source_references.quote: decides which A-Mab process parameters are characterized, and by what kind of study

statements.statement_text: The assessment is executed before any characterization study, and the Process Characterization Plans carry out the scope it defines.

source_references.quote: It is performed before any characterization study is executed

statements.statement_text: The assessment classifies no parameter: the CPP, WC-CPP, KPP and GPP designations are outputs of the characterization studies and are assigned in PCR-003 to PCR-010 and consolidated in PCMR-001.

source_references.quote: It does not classify any parameter

statements.statement_text: The assessment calculates no residual risk, because the control strategy that would reduce the risk is not yet defined; what is recorded is the risk as it stands with the controls that exist today.

source_references.quote: It also calculates no residual risk

statements.statement_text: 37 process parameters of the drug-substance train (Steps 3 to 10) are in scope.

source_references.quote: The assessment covers the 37 process parameters of the drug-substance train

statements.statement_text: The severity of a parameter is inherited from the most critical attribute it can affect, so criticality never depends on how well a facility controls a parameter.

source_references.quote: its severity is inherited from the most critical attribute it can affect

statements.statement_text: Occurrence and detection are scored as they stand before characterization, so the initial risk priority number is a ranking device on an ordinal scale.

source_references.quote: Occurrence and detection are scored as they stand before characterization

statements.statement_text: Parameters that can reach a viral-clearance attribute take the lowest detection band, because clearance is demonstrated in small-scale spiking studies and is never measured on the batch.

source_references.quote: clearance is demonstrated in small-scale spiking studies and is never measured on the batch

statements.statement_text: 21 of the 37 parameters can affect at least one quality attribute; the remaining 16 act on process performance only.

source_references.section_title: Parameter risk ranking by unit operation
heading_path: Parameter risk ranking by unit operation
source_references.quote: 21 of them can affect at least one quality attribute, and the remaining 16 act on process performance only

statements.statement_text: The highest initial risk number in the assessment is 700, and every parameter that reaches it belongs to one of the three steps credited with viral clearance.

source_references.section_title: Parameter risk ranking by unit operation
heading_path: Parameter risk ranking by unit operation
source_references.quote: The highest initial risk number in the assessment is 700

statements.statement_text: The campaign scope is 22 parameters in a multivariate design, 14 in univariate assessment and 1 in a justified univariate assessment; no parameter is excluded from study.

source_references.quote: 22 parameters are assigned to a multivariate design, 14 to univariate assessment and 1 to a justified univariate assessment

statements.statement_text: The assignment is prospective and is revisited when the studies report; it predicts no classification and no design space.

source_references.quote: The assignment predicts no classification and no design space

statements.statement_text: One attribute, leached Protein A, has no parameter ranked against it, because it is governed by resin age, sanitization and cycle number rather than by an operating set-point.

source_references.quote: One attribute has no parameter ranked against it

statements.statement_text: Each step's assignment is handed to exactly one characterization plan.

source_references.quote: assignment is handed to one characterization plan
